tasks.short: Monitor gaming operations for regulatory and policy compliance

steps.what: Monitor establishment activities against gaming regulations and company procedures

tasks.design: Keep regulatory and procedural observation with the officer using surveillance {OTHER} and current requirements in {DOCS}. No rule coverage or reliable automatic compliance label is assumed for the diverse activities being monitored.
tasks.previous_blocker: Compliance depends on context and the applicable procedure, rather than a generic visual signal.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated capability in the digest removes casino compliance observation time.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing an actual procedural breach from an incomplete view.
tasks.human_edge: Understand gaming practice and recognise when more evidence is needed.

reach.learn: Local gaming requirements and evidential limitations

evidence.claim: Contextual gaming compliance observation remains human; no applicable task-level saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is regulatory and company-procedure monitoring. Targeted cheating or theft observation, log writing and supervisor reporting are allocated to their narrower tasks; simultaneous observation time must be assigned once in a roll-up.
OTHER means surveillance viewing software. No inferred violation code, face identification or automated intervention is introduced.

Existing native viewing and recording functions continue without new configuration or runtime-saving credit. State-specific wording is interpreted as applicable national and local gaming requirements.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is proposed.
research_questions: Is any discrete compliance check fully specified and supported by reliable existing structured records?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Contextual compliance observation remains human.

tasks.short: Observe casino operations for irregular activity

steps.what: Observe casino operations for cheating, theft or other irregular activities

tasks.design: Keep gaming-specific irregularity observation with the officer using authorised surveillance {OTHER}. Shop gesture detection in the digest does not establish reliable casino cheating detection or permit removal of the officer's observation time.
tasks.previous_blocker: An unusual movement is not evidence of cheating without gaming context.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated casino-specific detection performance removes this observation work.
tasks.still_hard: Occlusion, legitimate variation and false suspicion.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise alternative explanations and gather corroboration.

evidence.claim: Veesion flags suspicious shop gestures for staff judgement; that capability does not establish casino cheating detection or labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is targeted observation for irregular conduct, excluding separate compliance monitoring, formal logs and supervisor reporting. Any common observation interval is owned once rather than added across tasks.
OTHER means surveillance viewing software. No new biometric identity, behaviour score or machine-produced allegation is assumed.
Native camera viewing and recorded playback remain available without new runtime-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new detection system or workflow is introduced.
unknowns: Gaming-specific detection validation and false-alert burden
research_questions: Does any proposed detector improve evidence quality on this setting without increasing unproductive review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. The digest does not justify reducing casino observation effort.

tasks.short: Report violations and suspicious observations to supervisors

steps.what: Report violations and suspicious behaviors with evidence and uncertainty to supervisors

tasks.design: Keep escalation and explanation with the officer, supported by factual records in {DOCS}. This boundary covers the communication and clarification; routine log compilation is changed only in the separate log-maintenance task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervisors need the context and evidential limits, not merely an alert label.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated tool removes the communication and clarification effort.
tasks.still_hard: Conveying urgency without overstating guilt or certainty.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what was observed and what remains inference.

evidence.claim: Contextual reporting and clarification remain human; no separate saving is established after log work is allocated elsewhere.

assumptions: Boundary is substantive verbal or written escalation and supervisor clarification, excluding observation and routine record compilation allocated separately.
No automatic allegation, external disclosure or enforcement action is introduced. Supervisor response time remains unchanged outside focal-role savings.
Native access to existing records continues with no new configuration or runtime-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because this communication workflow is unchanged.
unknowns: Escalation criteria and required briefing format
research_questions: Does improved log access reduce a distinct lookup burden without replacing clarification?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Escalation and clarification retain their time.

steps.what: Capture surveillance observations with times, locations and evidence references
Compile the surveillance log into the required chronological format
Check the log and accept the exact surveillance record

tasks.design: Configure native forms and chronological export in the incident-record {OTHER} before custom software. The officer captures factual observations once; fixed formatting creates a draft log that the officer checks before acceptance in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated chronological formatting adds effort after observations are recorded.
tasks.enabler_now: Native incident forms and deterministic exports can preserve captured facts without rewriting them.
tasks.still_hard: Separating direct observation from inference and keeping evidence references precise.
tasks.human_edge: Identify an inaccurate description before it becomes an accepted record.
tasks.altitude: Less log formatting, with factual responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Fixed incident forms and chronological exports can remove repeated formatting; this casino log design and its saving are model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary covers observation log capture, compilation and checking, excluding surveillance and supervisor briefing allocated separately.

Officer produces entry identifier, observation start and end with time zone, location, camera or source identifier, factual narrative, uncertainty, evidence time range and author in s1's 60 hours. Missing timestamps or evidence references prevent automatic compilation and return to manual completion in s3. No structured suspicion code is required.
OTHER means incident-record software and surveillance playback. Native forms and export are tested before custom code. Existing camera recording runtime earns no labour saving.
Only repeated formatting is removed; observation, factual capture and record checking retain their full shares. If native log exports already exist, the saving is zero.
unknowns: Existing log templates and export facilities
research_questions: Does native chronological export remove formatting time after evidence checks and field maintenance?
